5. ## Web implementation
6. 
7. ### Tokens
8. 
9. - Follow existing styles and named tokens if available.
10. - Otherwise, define named tokens via CSS custom properties: `--color-bg`, `--color-text`, `--color-muted-text`, `--color-link`, `--color-border`, `--color-focus`, `--color-danger`, `--color-success`.
11. - Only assign UI colors via these tokens.
12. - Avoid alpha (`opacity`, `rgba`, `hsla`) for text and primary UI boundaries if possible.
13. 
14. ### Forced Colors mode
15. 
16. Use `@media (forced-colors: active)` only when the default adaptation is insufficient. Inside, use CSS system color keywords — not fixed hex/RGB:
17. 
18. - `ButtonText`, `ButtonBorder`, `ButtonFace`, `CanvasText`, `Canvas`, `LinkText`, `HighlightText`, `Highlight`.

21.

23. .btn:focus {
24.   box-shadow: 0 0 4px 3px rgba(90, 50, 200, .7);
25.   outline: 2px solid transparent;
26. }
27. ```

32. @media (forced-colors: active) {

35. ```

38.
